title: TACG: Trajectory-Aware Commit Gating for Diffusion Language Model Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2607.03236v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Diffusion language models predict many masked positions at each denoising step, but their efficiency and output quality depend on which predictions enter the evolving context. Confidence is informative but incomplete for this decision: at matched confidence, proposals with different identity and support histories exhibit different one-step revision rates. We propose Trajectory-Aware Commit Gating (TACG), a training-free decoder that separates the current token proposal from the decision to commit it. TACG scores temporal support for the current proposal by contrasting its logits with an exponential moving average of earlier logits, requires the proposal identity to persist through a History Gate, and promotes a capped number of additional positions per step. translated_title: TACG：面向扩散语言模型解码的轨迹感知提交门控
translated_abstract: 扩散语言模型在每个去噪步骤中会预测多个被掩码的位置，但其效率和输出质量取决于哪些预测能够进入不断演化的上下文。置信度对于这一决策具有参考价值但并不完整：在相同置信度下，具有不同身份和支持历史的提案会表现出不同的单步修订率。我们提出了轨迹感知提交门控（TACG），这是一种无需训练的解码器，它将当前的词元提案与是否提交该提案的决策分离开来。TACG 通过将当前提案的 logits 与早期 logits 的指数移动平均进行对比，来评估该提案的时间支持度；通过历史门控要求提案身份保持持久性；并对每步提升的额外位置数量设置上限。该门控机制决定提交哪些位置以及何时提交；每个写入的词元都保持为当时的基准提案。在规定条件下的完整四任务 LLaDA 评估中……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了无需训练的轨迹感知提交门控解码器 TACG，通过时间支持度评分、历史身份门控和每步位置数量上限三项机制，将词元提案与提交决策分离，从而决定扩散语言模型每步去噪中应提交哪些预测，兼顾了解码效率与输出质量。
en_tdlr: TACG is a training-free decoder for diffusion language models that separates token proposal from commit decisions using temporal support scoring, history gating, and capped position promotion per step, improving both decoding efficiency and output quality.
